entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [iOS] BlazorWebView components not rendering on .NET 10 - Blazor starts but RootComponent is not injected into DOM #32894
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • MAUI Xaml SourceGen breaks when nullable is enabled and <WarningsAsErrors>Nullable</WarningsAsErrors> is set #32893
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • File Selector for iOS silently fails when app compiled in Release configuration. Succeeds when compiled in Debug configuration. #32887
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Android, iOS, Mac] Entry ClearButton not visible on dark theme Change #32886
  • [iOS] Text Color of the Entry, TimePicker and SearchBar is not properly worked on dynamic Scenarios #32885
  • [Android] ShellFlyout Footer area not cleared after removing footer view #32883
  • Style with setter on AbsoluteLayout.LayoutBounds and SourceGen fails #32879
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Windows] NavigationPage -> TabbedPage navigation crashes on second push with NavigationFailed (WinUI3) #32877

Closed

  • [Android] Programmatically creating FormattedString Spans with GestureRecognizers causes duplicate Command runs #21273
  • SourceGen does not work #32829
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • `dotnet pack` is not working with the .NET MAUI 10 Razor SDK Library project #32769
